project_name: RC-DCLP: Retention-Constrained DQN Continual Link Predictor
limits: Original DBLP dataset is not contained in the released ZIP
Historical LR anchor is reconstructed from chronological fit-only training data
Frozen predictor checkpoints do not contain optimizer or replay state and cannot be resumed in place
Retention metric uses the historical training-era validation tasks involved in checkpoint selection
Balanced sampled evaluation candidates; not a population-wide AP benchmark
